Counted sides correctly in 4 attempts.
Counted corners correctly in 1 of 3 attempts.
Named shapes from their sides and corners correctly in 7 attempts.
Identified triangles in different positions and circles as having zero corners.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, then naming shapes in different positions. Ayaan used the useful method of checking both the sides and the corners, and correctly identified triangles, squares, and circles. They were unsure when discussing how changing a shape could affect its corners; this was not clearly corrected before the lesson ended. At home, draw a few shapes and ask Ayaan to touch and count each side and corner aloud.
